Scope of Supply The successful bidder shall supply Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply as per th e specifications, quantity and requirements mentioned in the GeM Bid. 2. Technical Specifications Product: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply. Pipe Diameter: 50 mm. Total Required Length: 600 Metres. Type: Roll Pipes. Material: HDPE / Polyethylene suitable for water supply applications. The pipes shall be manufactured in accordance with applicable BIS/ISI stan dards for polyethylene pipes used in water supply, wherever applicable. The bidder shall clearly mention the PE Grade, SDR, PN Rating and relevan t technical specifications of the offered pipes in their bid. The pipes shall be new, unused and free from any manufacturing defects, cracks, damages or other visible defects. 3. The buyer reserves the right to inspect the material at the time of delivery. The supplier shall provide relevant test certificates, quality certificates and manufacturer details, wherever applicable. Any material found defective or not conforming to the specified requireme nts shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to the buyer. 4. Delivery Location The complete quantity of 600 metres of Polyethylene Pipes (50 mm Diameter, R oll Pipes) shall be delivered at the following location: Delivery Address: Ashok OCP, Piparwar Area, Chatra, Jharkhand – 829201. 5. Delivery Contact Person

Name: Mr. Ashish Kumar Mobile No.: 8340123466 The supplier shall coordinate with the above-mentioned contact person before d ispatch and delivery of the material. 6. Delivery and Transportation The supplier shall be responsible for transportation, loading, unloading and safe delivery of the material at the specified destination, as per the GeM Bi d terms. The entire quantity shall be delivered within the delivery period specified i n the GeM Contract. All transportation and delivery-related expenses shall be borne by the supplier, wherever applicable as per the bid conditions. The material shall be properly packed and secured to prevent damage duri ng transportation. 7. Warranty / Guarantee The supplier shall provide the applicable manufacturer's warranty against manu facturing defects and material defects as per the relevant product standards an d GeM contract conditions. 8. Documents to be Supplied The supplier shall provide the following documents along with the supply, wher ever applicable: Tax Invoice. Delivery Challan. Manufacturer's Test Certificate / Quality Certificate. Product Technical Datasheet. Warranty Certificate. BIS/ISI Licence details, if applicable. 9. Acceptance of Material Final acceptance of the supplied material shall be subject to physical inspection and verification of quantity, quality and conformity with the specifications menti oned in the GeM Bid. 10. General Conditions The bidder shall ensure that the offered product meets all technical and qu ality requirements mentioned in the bid. No substandard, refurbished or used material shall be accepted. The supplier shall be responsible for replacement of defective or damaged material at their own cost. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the GeM General Term s and Conditions (GTC) and applicable GeM Bid provisions.
